data_boundary: BUSBRA-only segmenter training; BUSI frozen external review only.

results.rationale: Use nested U-Net++ skip fusion with the DenseNet121 encoder reported as a strong BUSI backbone direction.
Keep the U-Net++ decoder while moving from ResNet18 to a deeper ResNet34 encoder.
Test whether a compact compound-scaled encoder gives cleaner ROI masks than ResNet18 under the same ROI protocol.
Use FPN to aggregate multi-resolution encoder features, matching the context and scale-robustness direction in BUS segmentation papers.
Combine the DenseNet121 encoder with a feature pyramid decoder as a medium-complexity alternative to U-Net++.
Use ASPP-style dilated context to test whether broader ultrasound texture context improves downstream ROI classification.
Use MAnet attention blocks as a practical Attention U-Net style substitute available in the local SMP stack.
Test a lighter decoder with DenseNet121 to see if simpler masks transfer better to the fixed ROI gate.
Use PAN as a pyramid-attention segmentation baseline, covering the non-SAM attention/context family.
Use PSPNet pyramid pooling as another context-expansion baseline without introducing SAM-style prompt dependencies.
